narrations.en: The last three steps, the proof, are complete! narrations.es: ¡Los últimos tres pasos, la prueba, están completos! question_narrations.en: Final Step 3, What-If-Not Challenge! The last three steps, the proof, are complete! Starting from the basic definition and starting conditions (assumptions) given in '3rd year of high school (2019 school year)', which was the starting condition, and going through the algebraic idea of developing the given equation term by term according to the basic definition and symmetrically grouping the like terms and common factors, it was clearly confirmed that the final conclusion that the key theorems and relational expressions of '3rd year of high school (2019 school year)' always hold true is established. The key point to remember here is that if you simply memorize the conclusion formula, it cannot be applied even if the conditions are slightly modified, so you must first check what definition and initial idea you started from. Finally, ask a deeper question. If the conditions or order of this theorem are generalized one level, what kind of advanced problem will it develop into in the high school CSAT exam? Experiment by changing the values and shapes directly on the math homepage in the link in the description! What if we modify one condition here? Pose your own question on mathedu!
